title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-17

ai_review.summary: Cranky audience tape but features a standout, highly praised Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording is an old, somewhat rough audience tape that many describe as "cranky," yet it captures one of the most interesting Dark Stars ever heard. Reviewers note the performance’s uniqueness and recommend giving it a listen despite its technical limitations. No other specific songs or band moments are highlighted.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is strong thanks to an acclaimed Dark Star, but the recording is dated and low‑fidelity; with only two reviews the assessment is moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cranky, aged tape with limited clarity; typical of early audience recordings but still listenable for the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on overall set flow; focus is on the Dark Star performance.
